goal: Preserve the original J-TEXT source, waveform predictor and all five intra-shot correction stages. Replace preparation and alarm policy independently.
pending_original_assets: 12 distinct original model/fit/provenance assets absent locally; original current_5 score archive also incomplete. No replacement source allowed.
scope: New baseline-preserving experiment. Archived protocols and zero_cold_start exploratory files remain unchanged.

user_overrides_for_this_experiment.order: Ascending integer HDF5 shot ID, not Ip, DBC or archived commissioning order
user_overrides_for_this_experiment.source_model: Original J-TEXT source unchanged; no source retraining or substitute checkpoint
user_overrides_for_this_experiment.intra_shot: Keep the original waveform predictor and all five correction stages
user_overrides_for_this_experiment.objective: Maximize timely TPR subject to FPR strictly less than 0.20

cohort_contract.chronological_meaning: Ascending integer shot ID only; no claim of verified acquisition-date order
cohort_contract.signal_time_authority: data channel attrs StartTime and SampleRate

frozen_source_contract.missing_assets_action: Report exact missing assets; do not retrain J-TEXT or use the new zero_cold_start source

preserved_pipeline.input: 23 values plus 23 availability lanes; original feature definitions and masking
preserved_pipeline.encoder: Original Simple23; past 128 samples, patch 8, 64-dimensional representation
preserved_pipeline.risk_readout: 111-dimensional path consisting of 64 encoder, 23 causal motion-coherence and 24 temporal features, plus bias; not replaced by the built-in 64-dimensional source head after preparation
preserved_pipeline.auxiliary_predictor: Original direct 25-point, 10-channel waveform forecast decoder and its original source-trained artifacts
intra_stages: Forecast residual mean and slope memory
Innovation relative to qualified same-shot historical errors
preserved_pipeline.stage5_state: 15 adjacent patch pairs times 4 diagnostic groups; 60 temporary coefficients, not an additive score bump
preserved_pipeline.stage5_clock: Prediction issued at q, targets q+1 through q+25; feedback usable at q+26, extra 5-sample wait, then original 8-sample handoff
preserved_pipeline.stage5_constraints: Original zero-sum adjacent-token exchange, diagnostic validity, qualified-history selection and actual perturbation-norm limits
preserved_pipeline.reset: All original temporary intra-shot states reset at shot end
preserved_pipeline.parameter_updates: J-TEXT weights unchanged. Any changed target initialization or preparation-trained artifact is a separately named experimental factor with provenance. No unreported scorer or decoder changes.

chronological20_control.preparation_members: Actual first 20 integer-ID-ordered shots; verified 2 disruptive and 18 normal
chronological20_control.initial_predictions: Use original frozen pre-reveal source model and source threshold 0.7258946895599365 for shots 1 through 20; seal first alarms before reading those outcomes
chronological20_control.preparation_fit: Fit only on the actual 20 ended chronological shots, using the original feature path and loss semantics
chronological20_control.normal_calibration: Leave out each of the 18 ended normal preparation shots from both mapping and readout fitting; use held-out whole-shot peaks. Generalizing original hard-coded 12-fold rank handling requires its own verified adapter.

calibration_adapter_specification.conditions: Preserve original float32 crossing semantics and exclude the held-out normal shot from both mapping and readout fitting; reject insufficient-donor ranks rather than invent values
calibration_adapter_specification.limitation: Calibration bands are finite-sample initialization settings, not guarantees of subsequent or full-stream FPR

chronological20_control.no_back_scoring: Prepared mapping, readout and threshold must never revise the already sealed first20 predictions
chronological20_control.limited_positive_evidence: Only 2 positive preparation shots are available; report this limitation rather than reordering or adding future positive donors

fixed_for_all_pairs: Raw signal timebase and availability contract
Original feedback eligibility and qualified-history rules
paired_controls.scale_only: Keep risk scorer initialization, five-stage implementation, alarm and feedback budget fixed; change only the independently documented scale-prior factor. Confounded head or teaching changes are reported separately.
paired_controls.alarm_only: Use checksum-identical frozen score curves and identical original five-stage corrections; change only the alarm policy. Do not feed new threshold outcomes back into the scorer in this isolated pair.
paired_controls.static_vs_five_stage: Use the same initialization, scale map and alarm. Disable or enable only the original five-stage intra path; report any change in feedback availability and parameter perturbation dose.
paired_controls.timing_or_sham_controls: Keep feedback qualification and actual realized correction norms matched; do not compare raw requested update sizes as if they were realized doses.

scale_replacement_design.initial_scope: Density-gain-only, zero-offset alternatives matching the original preparation map; no broad per-shot affine re-centering
candidates: Independently sourced pre-existing device-scale prior with donor and extraction provenance
Qualified causal first-shot prefix estimate installed only after that shot ends, then frozen
Bounded robust accumulation of qualified earlier-shot prefixes with a declared prior
scale_replacement_design.information_contract: A scale prior cannot replace the target-supervised 111D risk readout or target-taught feedback map. Preserving their original fitted values before shot1 requires a qualified pre-existing coefficient bundle; same360 archived bundles remain diagnostic target priors.
scale_replacement_design.coordinate_contract: Source checkpoint scaler unchanged; source and target reference statistics use matched definitions. Every issued waveform forecast retains its map version so mature targets are encoded in that same coordinate system.

alarm_replacement_design.chosen_boundary: Pure alarm processor over immutable original risk curves and timestamps; no scorer or five-stage state mutation

candidates.name: robust_odds_reference
candidates.reference: Initial accepted logit median b0 and MAD scale s0
candidates.semantics: Shot-adaptive cutoff fixed after reference acceptance, not continuously dynamic

candidates.name: anchored_sequential_envelope
candidates.reference: Same frozen initial b0,s0 and prefix-derived kappa
candidates.semantics: Genuinely time-varying boundary driven by previous evidence; no precursor-chasing reference drift

alarm_replacement_design.startup_contract: Declare source fallback during reference collection; preserve its first alarms and separately count fallback-only false positives. If fallback alone exceeds35 normal-shot alarms, an additional OR branch cannot pass primary FPR.
alarm_replacement_design.validation_status: Formulations and synthetic arithmetic only; no original-model performance measured

synthetic_observations.bounded_score_example: p0=0.8,M=2: naive cutoff1.6 impossible; odds cutoff0.888889 finite
synthetic_observations.sequential_example: Frozen reference p0=0.10,s0=0.05,kappa=1,h=12; risk0.12 causes cutoff0.175487,0.154202,0.135075,0.117990 and crosses cumulative evidence at sample4

verification_sequence: Inventory and hash-verify original source, decoder, temporal branch, readout, teaching and production replay assets
Reproduce the original archived-order 146 timely and 34 false positives as a fidelity witness, if assets permit
Build and measure the same-architecture chronological 360 control before comparing changes
Compare scale-prior alternatives while holding alarm and all five stages fixed
Compare fixed versus dynamic alarms on checksum-identical score curves
Run static-versus-five-stage paired controls with the same selected alarm
Combine only verified alternatives and validate causality and the false-positive budget

acceptance.eligible_set_before_ranking: Only integer-ID-ordered 360-shot candidates with false_positives <= 35 and all protocol checks passed may be ranked
selection_rank: timely_true_positives descending within the eligible FP <= 35 set
mandatory_counts: per-shot alarm changes against matched control
acceptance.archived_fidelity_witness: Archived-order 146/34 reproduction is diagnostic-only and excluded from chronological acceptance and parameter selection

confound_controls: Archived 81.11% result belongs to the archived order; it is not assumed to hold on chronological order
A causal chronological 20-shot control may fit only its actual first 20 ended shots
Risk-readout fitting and threshold calibration are distinct operations
Target-fitted archived maps or readouts from these same 360 shots are labeled prior-assisted development diagnostics, not zero-target-information results
No full-cohort scaler fit, no future labels, no oracle shot ordering and no replacement of valid intra-shot correction modules
No new inference or parameter selection on the previously examined 2593-shot extension during this phase
